title.zh: 在索索贡省Gubat市镇设立契约登记官办事处并为此拨付所需资金的法案
title.en: An Act to Establish the Office of Register of Deeds in the Municipality of Gubat, Province of Sorsogon, and to Appropriate the Necessary Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act to Establish the Office of Register of Deeds in the Municipality of Gubat, Province of Sorsogon, and to Appropriate the Necessary Funds Therefor

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1965/ra_4216_1965.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
There is hereby established the office of the register of deeds in the Province of Sorsogon, with permanent office at the Municipality of Gubat, which shall perform all the duties and functions of the register of deeds for all the municipalities of the first district.
The present office of the register of deeds in the Municipality of Sorsogon, Province of Sorsogon, shall hereafter be the office of the register of deeds for all the municipalities of the second district.

The sum of fifty thousand pesos is hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the establishment, operation and maintenance of said new office during the fiscal year nineteen hundred and sixty-five. Thereafter, such sum as may be necessary for its operation and maintenance shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 19, 1965.
